Control adaptive regional folded-concave fitting

Source: R/arfc_control.R
arfc_control.Rd

arfc_control() collects numerical and adaptive-weight controls used by arfc() and arfc_select(). The defaults reproduce the computational convention used in the accompanying ARFC study. No training/validation split is created by these controls.

Usage

arfc_control(
  max_iter = 120L,
  tol = 1e-08,
  norm_floor = 1e-08,
  relative_cutoff_multiplier = 1e-04,
  cutoff_floor = 1e-08,
  refit = TRUE,
  trace = FALSE,
  keep_matrices = FALSE,
  adaptive_alpha = 1,
  adaptive_epsilon_fraction = 0.05,
  adaptive_clip = c(0.25, 4),
  zero_tolerance = 1e-08,
  tie_relative_tolerance = 1e-12,
  strict = TRUE
)

Arguments

max_iter

Positive integer giving the maximum LQA iterations for each tuning candidate.

tol

Positive relative coefficient convergence tolerance.

norm_floor

Positive stabilizer for regional norms near zero.

relative_cutoff_multiplier

Nonnegative multiplier applied to the largest absolute smooth-pilot coefficient. The resulting threshold is used for exact coefficient thresholding.

cutoff_floor

Positive lower bound for the absolute threshold.

refit

Logical; refit the roughness-penalized model on retained basis coefficients after thresholding.

trace

Logical; retain exact-objective traces for tuning candidates.

keep_matrices

Logical; retain design and regional matrices in fitted objects. This can substantially increase object size.

adaptive_alpha

Positive exponent in the pilot-adaptive regional weights.

adaptive_epsilon_fraction

Positive fraction of the median positive pilot norm used in the stabilizing offset.

adaptive_clip

Two positive increasing numbers bounding normalized adaptive weights.

zero_tolerance

Nonnegative tolerance used only to display estimated zero regions in plots.

tie_relative_tolerance

Nonnegative relative tolerance for validation loss ties in arfc_select().

strict

Logical. If TRUE, only successful, converged, successfully refitted candidates with finite coefficients and BIC are eligible.

Value

An object of class arfc_control.
